# Blazonshots LTD

> Blazonshots LTD (RC 6906604) is a Lagos technology company. It publishes practical guides for Nigerian students and graduates, payroll and HR guides for employers, and builds Rosta, an HR and payroll platform for African businesses.

## Company

- [About](https://blazonshots.com/about.html): Who Blazonshots LTD is, our mission, and what we build.
- [Services](https://blazonshots.com/services.html): Digital product development, student engagement platforms, and business visibility tools.
- [Rosta](https://blazonshots.com/rosta.html): HR and payroll platform for businesses, payroll bureaus and HR firms across Africa.
- [Products](https://blazonshots.com/apps.html): Rosta and the Blazonshots student platform (in development).
- [Editorial Team](https://blazonshots.com/team.html): Who runs the blog and how articles are produced.
- [Contact](https://blazonshots.com/contact.html): How to reach us for business, partnership, or support enquiries.

## Blog
